description: Red Viaria de Aragón is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by icearagon.aragon.es. This set of spatial data is made up of different layers of geographical information alluding to the road infrastructures (roads, roads, streets) existing in the Autonomous Community of Aragon. The data available from the DG have been taken into account for its implementation. Roads and DG. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Aragon Road Network" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Autovías, Carreteras Nacionales, Travesía, Red básica, Senda, Camino. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
